units.source_text: 翌日，我跟在先生后面下了海，然后跟着他朝同一个方向游去。

en.t: The next day, I followed Sensei into the sea, then swam after him in the same direction.

units.source_text: 游出二百多米时，先生转过头来和我说话。

en.t: When we had swum more than two hundred meters out, Sensei turned his head and spoke to me.

units.source_text: 望向四周，辽阔的碧海上只漂浮着我们两个人，

en.t: Looking around, I saw that only the two of us were floating on the vast blue sea,

units.source_text: 耀眼的阳光照射着目之所及的山山水水。

en.t: and the dazzling sunlight shone over all the mountains and waters as far as the eye could see.

units.source_text: 我挥动充斥着自由与喜悦的臂膀，在水中飞快地游起来。

en.t: I swung my arms, filled with freedom and joy, and began swimming swiftly through the water.

units.source_text: 先生突然停下来，仰面朝天地躺在波浪起伏的海面上，

en.t: Sensei suddenly stopped and lay face upward on the wave-tossed surface of the sea,

units.source_text: 我也学着先生的样子躺在水面上。

en.t: and I too lay on the water, imitating him.

units.source_text: 朗朗晴空，碧蓝如洗，阳光洒在我的脸上，

en.t: The clear sky was a washed blue, and sunlight poured over my face,

units.source_text: 我大声喊道：“好舒服啊！”

en.t: so I shouted loudly, “This feels wonderful!”

units.source_text: 过了一会儿，先生直起上身，恢复了泳姿，催促我说：“该回去了吧？”

en.t: After a while, Sensei raised his upper body, resumed his swimming posture, and urged me, “Shall we go back?”

units.source_text: 我身体比较壮实，本想在海里再玩一玩，

en.t: I was fairly sturdy and had wanted to play in the sea a little longer,

units.source_text: 可是先生这么一说，我立刻痛快地答应：“好，回去吧。”

en.t: but when Sensei said that, I immediately agreed readily, “All right, let’s go back.”

units.source_text: 于是我们又顺着原路游回了海边。

en.t: So we swam back to the shore along the same route.

units.source_text: 从那以后，我就和先生成了朋友，只是尚不知先生住在何处。

en.t: After that, Sensei and I became friends, though I still did not know where he was staying.

units.source_text: 又过了两天，记得是第三天的下午，

en.t: Two more days passed; I remember it was the afternoon of the third day,

units.source_text: 我在茶屋遇到先生的时候，先生突然问我：“你打算在这里住很久吗？”

en.t: when I met Sensei at the teahouse, and he suddenly asked me, “Do you plan to stay here long?”

units.source_text: 我没有想过这个问题，一时间答不上来，

en.t: I had not thought about that question and could not answer for a moment,

units.source_text: 便回答：“我也不知道。”

en.t: so I replied, “I don’t know either.”

units.source_text: 可是看到先生在微笑，我突然觉得不好意思起来，

en.t: But when I saw Sensei smiling, I suddenly felt embarrassed,

units.source_text: 不由得反问道：“先生呢？”

en.t: and could not help asking back, “What about you, Sensei?”

units.source_text: 这是我第一次叫他“先生”。

en.t: That was the first time I called him “Sensei.”
